password.heading: Change password
password.note: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.body: This removes your account from {{server}} and signs you out everywhere. It can't be undone.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.confirmBody: Enter your password to delete the account {{username}} for good.
delete.lastAdmin: You're the only admin, and this server needs one. Make someone else an admin first, then delete your account.

browsers.heading: Browsers
browsers.lead: Every browser where you're signed in to {{server}}.

others.none: No other browser was signed in.
others.failed: Couldn't sign out the other browsers. {{reason}}

everywhere.title: Log out everywhere?
everywhere.body: This signs you out in every browser and every linked app, this one included.

linked.heading: Linked devices
linked.empty: Nothing is linked yet. Apps you sign in to with this account, like the isshoni desktop app when it arrives, show up here.

device.heading: This device
device.lead: Get a notification when friends start sharing, even while isshoni is closed.
device.on: On: this device gets isshoni's notifications.
device.off: Off: this device gets no notifications.
device.checking: Checking what this browser can do…
device.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive within a few seconds.
device.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.

install.lead: Install isshoni to open it like an app, from your home screen or dock.

prefs.heading: What to tell me about
prefs.lead: These choices apply to every device where your notifications are on.
prefs.shareStartedHint: Not while you're in that room already: then you see it.
prefs.adminAlertsHint: Sign-up requests, new admins, password resets and other changes to the server.

push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.setupFailed: This browser couldn't turn on notifications. Check that they aren't turned off in its settings, then try again.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for isshoni in this browser. To get them, allow notifications for this site in the browser's site settings, then reload the page.

unsupported.browser: This browser can't show isshoni notifications. Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari can.
unsupported.ios: This version of iOS can't show isshoni notifications. Update to iOS 16.4 or later.
unsupported.server: Notifications are turned off on this server.

card.title: Get a notification when friends start sharing?
card.installBody: It opens like an app, from your home screen.

homeScreen.title: Add isshoni to your Home Screen
homeScreen.lead: Add isshoni to your Home Screen to get notifications (iOS 16.4 or later).
homeScreen.step3: Open isshoni from your Home Screen.
homeScreen.login: You'll log in once more inside the app: Home Screen apps keep their own sign-in.
homeScreen.chatApp: Opened this from a chat app? Use its ⋯ menu → Open in Safari first.

appLaunch.title: Turn on notifications?
appLaunch.body: isshoni can tell you when friends start sharing, even while the app is closed.

download.title: Desktop app
download.coming: The isshoni desktop app is coming (Windows first). It keeps Discord and other voice apps out of what friends hear.
download.untilThen: Until then, share from Chrome or Edge: pick a Window and keep Share audio on.
